notes.title: Working on Update + Future
notes.content: Working on an update to fix some really annoying sound bugs. It's very frustrating to work on these old games because they were poorly programmed compared to what I've learned this year. I will do my best to fix the sound bugs. Moving forward any new Comit games will be made with a new engine and better organized code. I'm dropping the prices of the original Comit games to $0.99. I'm very excited for what the future holds.
